decisionDate.title: decisionDate
decisionDate.description: The expected or actual date of the admission decision.

found.title: found
found.description: True only if the application number and email both match a record. If false, share no application details.

missingItems.title: missingItems
missingItems.description: Documents still needed to complete the application. Blank if nothing is missing.

program.title: program
program.description: The graduate program the student applied to.

status.title: status
status.description: Current application status, such as Submitted, Incomplete, Under Review, Interview Scheduled, Admitted, or Waitlisted.

term.title: term
term.description: The term the student applied for, such as Fall 2027.
